criteria.rationale: Verified: CarriedFrom separates carried from executed checks and the delivery reader takes the carried head and time. D1 states that the fixture record is hand-written with a placeholder provenance digest. Residual: material-binding currency of a carried record is not exercised end to end and D1 overstates the change-set shape (N9).
The added Carried Checks section is declared by the spec and documented; runs without carried checks render as before; log parsing, report history and result schema are unchanged.

The cause was the summary treating every check as executed; branching on CarriedFrom before commands and results are built meets R1 and R2, and D1 gives the basis for the R3 fixture shape. The design assessment lists no structural delta.
Read the changed paragraph in the English, pt-BR and embedded manuals; it matches the observed report: carried section, absence from commands and results, and the all-carried statement.
Carried lines name outcome, check, source head, time, and skip reason or exit code. The placeholder wording in a carried and skipped run is N7.

Changes are the declared artifacts; carry eligibility and selection are untouched. R3 was reworded after round 1 with decision D1; spec lint reports no amendment failure. The origin follow-up disposition remains (N10).
No new input, path or authority: fields come from the repository canonical result already used as carry base and are only written to the report; sealing rules are unchanged.
One summary field, one report section and a small guard are sufficient. The guard depends on the result line prefix produced by validationSummaryOf and would need revisiting if that shape changed.

findings.action: State that no command was executed for a structured run with carried and skipped checks only.
findings.rationale: When no command ran, at least one check was carried and another was skipped, Validation Commands reads _Fill manually_ in an automatic report instead of saying nothing ran. Reproduced with a real validate --carry --report run.

findings.action: Assert the skip reason and exit code on carried lines.
findings.rationale: No test builds a carried check with a skip reason or exit code, so removing the R1-N6 fix would not fail the tests read in this round. The exit code was observed in a real run.

findings.action: Correct the D1 wording or add a carried-record case with material provenance.
findings.rationale: D1 says the fixture carries from a change-set commit as a real carry does, but a real carry takes the base record head, which need not belong to the spec, and real records carry material and scope provenance that govern currency. No end-to-end case read in this round seals a carried check through the material binding.
